Adds `specs/minds-first-run-onboarding/spec.md`, the design for the minds desktop app's chat-style first-run start flow (the loading document's intro, the `/start` conversation, the creation page as its tail, and the persisted `is_onboarding_complete` flag).

`uncertainties.md` records that `specs/minds-onboarding/concise.md` describes the retired welcome-splash flow and is superseded by the new spec for the first run.
